name: Haiku global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Emerging market recovery positioning via Chinese tech leaders (TCEHY, BABA) and emerging markets ETF, combined with semiconductor infrastructure plays (ASML, TSM, ARM) poised to benefit from ongoing AI capex buildout. Complemented by developed-market quality companies (SAP, NVO, NFLX) and international diversification through regional ETFs. The portfolio leverages geographic diversification and sector exposure uncorrelated with S&P 500 concentration.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This portfolio captures emerging market recovery opportunities through Chinese tech exposure and ETF holdings, combines semiconductor infrastructure enablers positioned to outperform during AI infrastructure buildout, includes developed-market quality and healthcare diversification via SAP and NVO, and maintains broad geographic exposure through IEMG and EFA. The concentration on semiconductor equipment/design (non-consumer) and China reflects a thesis that these areas will outperform broad S&P 500 through H1 2026.
